name: Simple Invoice
tagline: Write an invoice on your phone and save it as a PDF.
audience: Sole proprietors and small service businesses in Canada
before: A one-off invoice means opening a spreadsheet, looking up the tax, and hoping the printout looks right.
after: Fill in your business, the customer and the lines. The tax follows the province you pick. Print it, or save it as a PDF from the browser's print window.
privacy_note: Your business details and the invoice you are writing stay in this browser. Nothing is sent to us.
origin: Tax rates match the GST/HST Calculator on this site, from the Canada Revenue Agency general-rate table.
built_with: One web page. The PDF is made by your browser's print window.
